tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i mchod chog yid bzhin re skong nor bu'i gru char zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i mchod chog yid bzhin re skong nor bu'i gru char zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i mchod chog yid bzhin re skong nor bu'i gru char zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ swasti/ bde gshegs rgyal kun skyed pa'i yum// bde legs dngos grub mchog stsol ma// dge tshogs rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas gter// dge ba'i dpal sbyin gang der 'dud// gang zhig mchog dngos grub pa'i char// myur stsol lha yi lhar gyur ma'i// mchod bstod cho ga yid bzhin gyi// re skong nor bu 'dir bkod bya// bslab gsum gang rung ldan pa yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed byas shing*// 'chi med lha mo bsgrub pa la// sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi// thog mar bshams bkod rim pa la// bzhir dbye dus ni tshe bsod nams// ye shes rgyas phyir nya stong brgyad// sgrib sbyong bar chad sel la sogs// skabs dang mthun par brtsam gnas ni// gtsug lag khang ngam dben pa'i gnas// gtsang byas tshogs kyi rten bkod ni// rnam par rgyal ma'i mchod rten nam// sku brnyan drung ngam maṇ+ḍal la// 'bru dkar dri bzang sbags pa yi// tshom bu lha grangs mnyam par dgod// gzhan yang gsang gsum rten gang 'byor// bkram zhing mchod pa'i rdzas bkod ni// me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas la sogs rim bzhin du// stod du tshang par 'du bya zhing*// mchod gtor bsang chu gzhan yang ni// mchod pa'i bye brag rnam mang zhing*// rgya chen bkod mdzes steng 'og dang*// phyogs mtshams gdugs dang bla res sogs// rgyan gyi yo byad ji snyed pa// gtsang zhing yid 'ong 'god nas su// bde ba'i stan la 'khod byas nas// gnyis pa cho ga'i sngon 'gro gsum// dang po skyabs sems tshad med ni// bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//

lan gsum sogs kyis skyabs su 'gro/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i bsnyen sgrub la 'jug par bgyi'o// lan gsum sems bskyed slar yang ni/ skyabs sems mdor bsdus bzung bar bya/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum tshad med bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /bdag nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i skur gsal bar gyur/ gnyis pa bsang chu sgrub pa ni/ sems ma rdo rje ma yi rgyas// ku sha'i 'thor g.yab 'dzin nas su// bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rang bzhin du// mos la sngags 'di nyer gcig bzla'o// oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum pa gnas dang yo byad rnams// byin brlab phyir du bsang chu 'thor// oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswabhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams ye shes kyi rang bzhin/

mchod pa'i rnam pa zag med bde chen gyi rgyu bla na med pa'i mkha' dbyings thams cad yongs su khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dha rma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pra dzñā pa ra mi ta na da saṃ bha wa te/ badz+ra dharma hri da ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum byin gyis brlab nas su// gnyis pa dngos gzhir rnam pa lnga// mdun bskyed tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa// mchod cing bstod 'bul sngags bzla zhing*// 'dod don gsol gdab lnga'i dang por// oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten du gyur pa ni/ rin po che'i rang bzhin seng khri'i steng du pad+ma/ de'i steng du khri zlum po bang rim gsum brtsegs/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas pa/ steng du rin po che'i bre/ gdugs bcu gsum/ char khebs tog dang bcas pa/ me tog gi phreng ba dang dar gyi lda ldi sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// de'i bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bh+rūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ser ba/ g.yon sngo zhing yid tsam khro ba/ zhal re re zhing zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas pad+ma'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa bsnams pa/

gsum pas mda'/ bzhi pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon dang po zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang bcas pa/ gsum pas gzhu/ bzhi pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ g.yas rnga yab dang*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje sngon po/ g.yas rnga yab dang g.yon rdo rje sngon po 'dzin pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi phyogs bzhir khro bo bzhi gnas pa ni/ shar du mi g.yo ba g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar ba// nub tu dbyug sngon can g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ byang du stobs po che g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing kha rab tu khros pa/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod cing*/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po thor tshugs su byas pa/ stag lpags dang*/ sbrul gyi rgyan can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o// gtso mo'i steng gi nam mkha' la gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas gtso mo la sku khrus gsol ba/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūm̐ dkar po/ dpral bar trām̐ ser po/ lte bar hrīḥdamar po/ brla gnyis la aṃ a ljang gu/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs nas/ oṃ uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med du gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag /chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/ phyag na rdo rje dang khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dkon mchog spyi tshogs kyi zhing dam par spyan drangs pa ni/ bdag dang mdun gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad mchod pa'i yul du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs bdag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes pas gsol btab spyan drangs nas/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas phyi 'brangs bgegs bskrad cing*// de nas bzhugs gsol gdan 'bul ni// bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// pad+ma 'dab rgyas ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs pa 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// gyad dang seng ges btegs pa'i khri// dar dang rin chen rgyan spras steng*/

pad+ma zla ba'i gdan grangs med// phul bar dgyes bzhin bzhugs par gyur// oṃ badz+ra sidha a sa na pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ don tshan gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i lha tshogs dang*/ dkon mchog mchod zhing dam pa'i drung*/ mchod sprin spro zhing spel ba'i phyir/ gzungs sngags zab mo lan gsum bklag / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra marda nā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā te dzo badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ṭo pa saṃ kra ma ṇi sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ne swā hā/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ ye shes bde ba chen po'i dngos// mchod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// dpal gyi lha mo rnam rgyal ma// rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ye shes bde ba chen po'i dngos// zhabs bsil bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'di// dpal gyi lha mo rnam rgyal ma// rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la 'bul// pā d+yaṃ/ lha yi me tog sna tshogs pa// yongs 'du maṇ+ḍal ra ba dang*// 'dab brgya ut+pal ku muta sogs// 'bul gyi bdag la dgyes par mdzod// puṣ+pe/ sna tshogs dri zhim spos kyi mchog /zhing kun khyab par byed pa 'di// 'chi med lha mo la 'bul gyi// tshe dbang dngos grub stsol phyir bzhes// dhū pe/ sna tshogs nor bu'i snang gsal dang*// bgegs 'joms mar me'i phreng ba 'di// mchog tu dgyes pas bzhes su gsol// blo dang mchog gi dngos grub stsol// ā lo ke/ bzhi mnyam sbyar ba'i dri mchog 'di// lha yi dri bzang phye ma dang*// byugs pa yis kyang byugs par bya// rdzu 'phrul dngos grub bdag la stsol// gan+dhe/

bza' ba bca' ba'i khyad par dang*// sna tshogs bdud rtsi'i zhal zas ni// btung ba'i bye brag 'bum dang sbyar// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab par mdzod// nai wi d+ya/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /shab+da/ bar gyis mchod/ de nas rgyal srid bdun 'bul ba/ 'phags ma mchog dang rgyal ba sras bcas la// rin chen du ma las grub rtsibs stong ldan// mkha' la mngon 'phags 'khor lo 'di 'bul bas// srid zhir mi gnas 'phags lam mnga' brnyes shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya tsakra rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ 'phags ma mchog dang rgyal ba sras bcas la// srid gsum kun dgar byed pa'i snang ba can// re skong yid bzhin nor bu rin chen 'bul// nyon mongs dbul sel chos la longs spyod shog /ma ṇi rat+na= 'phags ma mchog dang rgyal ba sras bcas la// shes rab rang bzhin sgeg cing lang tsho ldan// bde chen skyed gzhi btsun mo rin chen 'bul// 'khor ba las sgrol rgyal ba'i sras gyur shog /s+t+rī rat+na= 'phags ma mchog dang rgyal ba sras bcas la// gzur gnas blo can zab cing gting dpag dka'// phyogs las rnam rgyal khyim bdag rin chen 'bul// skye 'gro'i rgud sel rdzogs ldan dus bzhin shog /pu ru ṣa rat+na/ 'phags ma mchog dang rgyal ba sras bcas la// kai la sha ri dang mtshungs stobs bcu ldan// thal dkar mche ba drug gis mdzes pa phul// 'chi bdag dpung gzhom rdo rje gsum brnyes shog /hasti rat+na= 'phags ma mchog dang rgyal ba sras bcas la// gung gnyis gling bzhi bskor ba'i myur mgyogs rtsal// rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan cang shes rta mchog 'bul// bar chad las sgrol yid la 'dod 'jo shog /a shwa rat+na= 'phags ma mchog dang rgyal ba sras bcas la// phas rgol mthar byed dpa' bo rngam brjid can// mthu stobs gzi ldan dmag dpon rin chen 'bul// bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal sangs rgyas bstan 'phel shog

/khaṅga rat+na/ de nas 'dod yon lnga mchod ni/ rgyal ba'i gtsug tor las byung rje btsun ma// lha tshogs ma lus 'khor dang bcas rnams la// gzugs kyi bye brag yid 'ong gang dag dang*// sgra yi rnam pa srid na mchis so cog /dri mchog sbyar dang byugs pa'i tshogs ji snyed// bshos gtsang ro brgya dang ldan lha'i zhal zas/ reg 'jam rin thang bral ba'i na bza' sogs// 'dod yon phul byung mchod pa'i sprin spro bas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /thugs rjes brtser dgongs 'chi ba med pa'i tshe// rgud med lang tsho rtag brtan gzhom bral bar// stan thog 'di ru byin rlobs dngos grub stsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya badz+ra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te ā hūm̐ swā hā/

de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul/ skabs gsum bdag po lha min g.yul rgyal nas// bkra shis lha mos mchod pas mdun bdar bzhin// bcom ldan 'das ma rgyal ba sras 'khor gyi// dbu la dar dang rin chen rgyan mdzes gdugs// spyan la gser nya ldem 'khyugs 'od 'tsher ba// gsung la dung dkar g.yas 'khyil grags snyan ldir// ljags la pad+ma 'dab stong ge sar bzhad// mgul la rin chen gter gyi bum pa bzang*// thugs la dpal gyi be'u rnam par bkra// sku la mi nub rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgreng// zhabs la dzam+bu'i gser 'khor rtsibs stong can// bdag gzhan bsod nams tshogs chen spel ba'i phyir// lhag bsam dad pa'i mos blos kun blangs nas// 'bul gyi brtse bar dgongs te bzhes nas kyang*// tshe dang dpal dang grags dang mthu stobs dang*// 'byor pa gzi brjid ye shes snang bas khyab// mi shigs rdo rje gsum ldan dwangs ma'i lus/ yongs grub 'chi med rtag bde'i rang bzhin du// thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya aṣ+ṭa maṅga la pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ de nas bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'bul/ sngon tshe lha yi lhar gyur sgyu 'phrul sras// bcom ldan dgra rgyal dge sbyong chen po'i drung*// gsang ba'i bdag dang brgya byin la sogs kyis// bde legs rdzas brgyad phul ba slar yang ni// dge mtshan nyid du byin gyis brlabs ji bzhin// deng 'dir bde gshegs gtsug tor lha mo mchog /rgyal sras slob dang sprul 'khor bcas pa la// yungs kar dūrba bil ba gi'u wam̐// li khri zho mchog me long dung dkar po// rmad byung mchod pa'i rdzas brgyad 'di 'bul bas// bdag gzhan 'di nas snying po byang chub bar// tshe rabs rtag tu bkra shis yon tan gyi// dpal dang ldan pa'i bde legs kun 'byung ba'i// brtse chen thugs rjes khyab par mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya aṣ+ṭa maṅga la dra bya pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/

de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni// rgyas par yan lag bdun pa dang*// tshom bu so bdun bkod pa 'bul// bsdu na tshom bu bdun pa dang*// 'brel ba'i mchod cing bsngo ba sogs// spyi 'gro bzhin du dbul bar bya// skabs 'dir bstod phyag 'bul phyir 'jug /spro na stong phrag mchod pa'i tshogs// 'bul zhing thugs rje bskul ba ni// rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri// zhal zas la sogs mchod pa'i rdzas// kun bzang smon lam las byung ba'i// mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i mdzod// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// 'phags ma rnam rgyal lha yi tshogs// ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la 'bul gyi bzhes// thugs rje'i gter chen mchog rnams kyis// bdag gzhan tshe dpal ye shes dang*// don gnyis grub par byin gyis rlobs// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da/ rnams kyis 'bul zhing*/ na ma sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa bh+yaḥ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra a war te bh+yaḥswā hā/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs rnams la// mchod cing bsnyen bkur zhabs spyi bos// 'dud cing phyag byas mtshungs par 'gyur// de ltar mchod pa stong rtsa 'bul// gsum pa bstod phyag 'bul ba ni// rab 'byams bder gshegs thugs rje'i klong yangs nas// rab gsal nyin byed snang bas bskyed pa yis// rab mdzes pun+ḍā ri ka rgyas pa'i dbus// rab dge'i dri bsung dang ldan bcom ldan ma// rtsa zhal zla bzhin mtshar sdug g.yas ser 'dzum// g.yon sngo khro nyams mche bas ma mchu gnon// zhal re la'ang ut+pal dang 'dra'i spyan// gsum ldan kun gzigs ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag brgyad g.yas bzhi sna tshogs rdo rje dang*// 'od dpag med mgon mda' dang mchog sbyin te// g.yon bzhi sdigs mdzub zhags bsnams tshe bum bzung*// gzhu dang skyabs sbyin 'gro sgrol phyag 'tshal bstod// 'chi med na chung sgeg pa'i lang tsho can// 'chi med lha rdzas rin chen nor bus brgyan// 'chi med bdag po tshangs dbang phyag gi gnas/

'chi med mchog ster ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// steng gi phyogs nas lha yi bu gnyis kyis// yan lag brgyad ldan khrus gsol g.yas g.yon du// nor bu pad+ma can dang gsang ba'i bdag /rnga yab 'dzin cing phyogs bzhir khro bo'i rgyal// mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon stobs po che// g.yas rnams ral gri lcags kyu dbyug pa dang*// rdo rje g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub gtum rngams can// ma rung bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag sogs dad dang mos pa rnam dag gis// lha khyod bskul mthus dam bcas thugs bskyed pa// brtser dgongs tshe dbang bsod nams ye shes gzi// rgyas shing bsam don 'bad med 'grub byin rlobs// bzhi pa bsnyen sngags bzla ba ni/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma rnam par rgyal ma'i thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+rūm̐ yig dkar po'i mtha' skor du gzungs sngags kyi yig 'bru las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas mchod cing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ bdag gzhan sems can rnams kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ 'od zer tshur 'dus rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang brtan g.yo snod bcud kyi dwangs ma thams cad rang la thim nas tshe dpal bsod nams ye shes 'byor pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dngos grub thob par gyur par mos la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba trai lo kya pra ti bi shiṣ+ṭā ya/ bud+dhā ya te na maḥ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ a sa ma sa man+ta a ba bha sa s+pha ra ṇa ga ti/ ga ga na swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe/ a bhi ṣiñtsan+tu māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga tāḥ su ga ta ba ra ba tsa na a mṛ ta a bhi ṣe kai ra ma hā mu drā man+t+ra pa daiḥ ā ha ra ā ha ra/ ma ma ā yus+saṃ dhā ra ṇi/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha bi sho dha ya/ ga ga na swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe/

uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi dza ya pa ri shud+dhe/ sa ha sra rasmi sañtso di te/ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki ni/ ṣaṭ+pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi/ sarba ta thā ga ta mā te/ da sha bhū mi pra tiṣ+ṭhi te/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ a dhiṣ+ṭha na adhiṣ+ṭhi te/ mu dre mu dre/ ma hā mu dre/ badz+ra kā ya saṃ ha ta na pa ri shud+dhe/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shud+dhe/ pra ti ni warta ya ma ma ā yur/ bi shud+dhe sarba ta thā ga ta/ sa ma ya a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni/ bi mu ni bi mu ni ma hā bi mu ni/ ma ti ma ti ma hā ma ti/ ma ma ti su ma ti ta thā ta/ bhū ta ko ṭi pa ri shud+dhe/ bi s+phu ṭa/ bud+dhi shud+dhe/ he he dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ sma ra sma ra/ s+pha ra s+pha ra/ s+phā ra ya s+phā ra ya/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bud+dhe bud+dhe/ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re/ su badz+re badz+re gar+bhe dza ya gar+bhe/ bi dza ya gar+bhe/ badz+ra dz+wā lā ghar+bhe/ badz+rod+bha be/ badz+ra saṃ bha be/ badz+ra badz+ri ṇi/ badz+raṃ bha ba tu ma ma sha rī raṃ// sarba satwā nāñtsa kā ya pa ri shud+dhir+bha ba tu/ me sa dā sarba ga ti pa ri shud+dha ts+tsha/ sarba ta thā ga tā sh+tsa/ māṃ sa mā shwā sa yan+tu/ bu dh+ya bu dh+ya/ si dh+ya si dh+ya/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bi bo dha ya bi bo dha ya/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ bi mo tsa ya bi mo tsa ya/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ sa man+ta mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ sa man+ta rasmi pa ri shud+dhe/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ mu dre mu dre/ ma hā mu dre/ ma hā mu drā man+t+ra pā daiḥswā hā/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta ā yurda dai swāhā/ de ltar snying po dang nye snying*/ srung sngags dang bcas skabs bstun bzla/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.aṃ a/ bdag dang bsrung bya la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ gzungs ring stong phrag gcig bzla zhing*// bcom ldan 'das ma'i rgyud bskul bas// bdag la 'dod don ster bar mos// 'bum phrag rdzogs tshe rje btsun ma// mjal zhing mchog dngos stsol bar 'gyur// lnga pa 'dod don gsol gdab ni// snyim pa me tog bkang nas su// thal sbyar 'dud pa dang bcas nas// 'grengs bzhin sgo gsum rtse gcig blos//

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i dbang po'i gtsug tor las sprul pa'i lha mo rje btsun 'phags ma rnam par rgyal ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rab 'byams mtha' yas mu med kyi zhing du bzhugs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams dang*/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam pa chos kyi srung ma la sogs pa deng 'dir mchod pa'i zhing mchog tu bzhugs pa rnams bdag gzhan sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol/ gang 'dir bdag cag rnams kyis gzhan phan byang chub sems kyi mos pa rnam par dag pas kun nas bslang ba'i 'dod pa'i don thams cad thogs pa med par yid bzhin du 'bad med yongs su 'grub pa'i phyir/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i stobs dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyi byin gyis brlab pa'i mthu chen po bskyed nas thugs rje chen pos nye bar bzung bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyal dang rgyal bas bsngags 'os yon tan zhing*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rnam dag dri ma med// rgyal ba bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa mchog /rgyal ba shākya'i gtso bo'i ring lugs gang*// nges don mthar thug theg mchog snying po'i bstan// dar rgyas phyogs dang tha gru kun khyab par// dkar po'i phyogs kyi mel tsher brtson bzhin du// nyams med yun gnas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// der 'dzin skyong dang spel mkhas phrin las bdag /'gro ba'i yon gnas skyes bu mchog rnams kyang*// bstan 'gro'i don chen sgrub la gegs med cing*// dam pa'i rnam thar mthar phyin byin gyis rlobs// gzhan yang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde rgyas shing*// thos bsam sgom pa'i rtsa ba rab tu brtan// bstan dang bla mar gus mchod bslab gsum ldan/ lhar bcas bstod 'os nyid du byin gyis rlobs// bstan pa'i sgor zhugs mchis so cog thams cad// las 'bras blang dor ji bzhin spyod nas su// nyon mongs rlabs la mi byings thar pa'i grur// brten nas yang dag lam 'god byin gyis rlobs// gang dag grub mtha' gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi// srol 'dzin rnams kyang kun slong rang sar zhi// chos spang sgrib par mi 'gyur byang sems kyis// rgyud brlan phan tshun mthun par byin gyis rlobs// log phyogs bdud ris rloms pa'i bslu chos mkhan// ltar snang bzang brdzu'i tshul 'chos byis pa rnams// 'brid cing chos min chos ltar ston byed kun// ming gi lhag mar 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// de bzhin mtshams sbyor log pa las bskyed pa'i// mi dang mi min la sogs sprul byas nas// dngos su bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'tshe byed rnams// rtsad nas nyams shing zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// mnga' ris yul ljongs skyong ba'i mi bdag rnams// mchog gsum rgyal la lhag par dad bskyed nas// stobs kyis khur 'degs ngal med brtson bzhin du// sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba byed byin rlobs// de mthus 'phral dang yun gyi dge ba'i tshogs// chab srid 'khor 'bangs 'phel rgyas 'khrugs rtsod zhi// chos rgyal byang sems chen pos skyong ji bzhin// rdzogs ldan dang po'i dus ltar byin gyis rlobs// yid srubs byin zhugs bstan la sdang zhing rgol// 'gro la khrims 'gal log spyod duḥkhas gzir// rgyal khams mi dge'i las ngan sbyor ba rnams// mthu nyams rtsal zhan spa bkong byin gyis rlobs// skye dgu rnams kyang rtag tu dge ba bcu'i// chos ldan phan tshun nongs med mthun zhing brtse// rnam smin mi da

ge'i las rnams ring spangs nas// mtho ris yon tan thob par byin gyis rlobs// rtsod dus lnga brgya tha ma'i snyigs ma 'dir// mtha' yi dmu rgod log par sems pa yi// sangs rgyas bstan dang skye 'gro la sdang ba'i// hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par byin gyis rlobs// sa chu me rlung 'byung ba chen po rnams// 'khrugs pa'i rkyen gyis nang bcud sems can khams// g.yo zhing 'jigs pas nyen byed de dag kyang*// ldang ba med par zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// gshis ngan rkyen las gyur ba'i dus ma yin// 'chi ba rnam pa bco brgyad mi 'byung zhing*// 'jig pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug gi /gnod pa rtsad nas nyams par byin gyis rlobs// sman rnams bcud nus brtas shing nyer 'tsho'i gzhi// gsos su smin zhing 'byung po gnod sbyin dang*// sha za srin pos gnod 'tshe ring spangs nas// snying rje dang ldan gnyug mar gnas byin rlobs// 'jig rten khams kun bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// char chu dus 'bab lo legs 'bru 'phel zhing*// nad mtshon dbul ba'i bskal pa rgyang bsrings nas// sde bzhi'i dpal gyis 'tsho bar byin gyis rlobs// tshangs dang dpa' bo rgyal chen gtsang ris kyi// lha rnams stobs kyis dpung tshogs 'degs bzhin du// 'jig rten skyong la rtag tu g.yel med par// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul ches cher bskyed byin rlobs// ma 'ongs bskal bzang lnga pa mi pham mgon// byams chen dang ni drug pa seng ge yi// bstan pa ji srid shāka thub ring lugs rnams// de srid bar du yun gnas byin gyis rlobs// rgyal bka' 'khor lo gsum gyi dgongs pa'i don// gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta ba dang*// snga 'gyur 'od gsal rdo rje snying po yi// bzhed gzhung 'khrul med rgyun mi chad byin rlobs// bsil ri'i ljongs dbus lhar bcas mchod sdong che// ston pa'i rgyal tshab shākya mu ne mched// gdengs can gdul bya ring du bzhol nas su// 'dzam gling bsod nams zhing bzhugs byin gyis rlobs// gnas mchog phun tshogs mtshur

dpal kun spungs pa'i zhing*/ mchan/ gyi gan+dho la/ /dus ni phun tshogs rang bzhin rten cing 'brel/ /'dren pa phun tshogs pad+ma nyin byed dbang*/ mchan/ theg mchog rdo rje'i zhabs// bdag sogs mgon du bskal brgyar brtan byin rlobs// chos zab phun tshogs nges gsang bden pa'i don// 'khor ni phun tshogs sdom pa gsum dang ldan// lnga ldan phun sum tshogs pa'i bdag nyid can// gdod nas yongs grub rtag par brtan byin rlobs// bdag sogs rnal 'byor bsam pa'i don thams cad// 'bad pa med par yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// nad gdon bar chad 'gal rkyen kun sel zhing*// rtag tu lha khyod 'bral med byin gyis rlobs// ring du 'tsho ba'i tshe yi dngos grub kyi// sgo gsum smin grol dam pas sim pa dang*// longs spyod dbang 'byor gter chen bum bzang bzhin// rgyal la sri zhu 'gro phan nus byin rlobs// mos pa rnam bzhis dpal kun dbang bsgyur zhing*// mthu stobs rig sngags bden pas 'chang ba'i mthus// phas rgol gnod byed byad phur rbod gtong rnams// thal bar brlag pa'i nus thob byin gyis rlobs// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams khyod skur rdzogs// gang sku'i bkod pas zhing khams yongs khyab pa// thugs rje che mnga' khyod las gzhan su zhig /dmigs su ma 'tshal de phyir bdag byin rlobs// khyad par lha gcig bsnyen cing bsgrub lags na// rgyal kun bskyed yum bcom ldan rje btsun ma// dngos dang nyams kyi snang bar zhal bzang mthong*// lung bstan dbugs dbyung thob par byin rlobs// bdag sogs rnams kyi 'brel bcas mkha' mnyam gyi// mar gyur yongs dang rtsa ba'i pha ma yis// thog drangs 'gro ba rigs drug sems can rnams// sdug bsngal mtsho bsgral sangs rgyas thob byin rlobs// de ltar theg chen shing rtas nyer drangs pa'i// smon lam bsam 'phel dgos 'byung rin po che// 'gro ba'i gtsug nor bsod nams dpal thob nas// rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchod sprin 'gyur byin rlobs// bden grub bden gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin can// dkon mchog gsum dang 'phags ma gtso 'khor gyis// dbyings nas brtser dgongs ji ltar re ba'i 'bras// yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzad du gsol//

de ltar mchod cing 'dod ba'i don// rtse gcig mos pas gsol btab mthus// bcom ldan 'das ma dgyes zhal gyi// 'dzum mdangs zla ltar rgyas pa yis// rang gzhan gang gi don bya ba// de yi spyi bor phyag g.yas kyi// tha ma mchog sbyin phyag rgyas reg /byin rlabs mchog dngos stsol bar mos/ ༈ /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga'i rim pa la// gtor 'bul 'dod gsol gtang rag mchod pa dang*// bstod cing nongs bshags bsdu rim bsngo smon dang// shis pa brjod bcas rnam pa brgyad du bstan// de yang dang po gtor ma 'bul ba ni// a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba rin po che las grub pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen po kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum mam lan bdun gyis byin brlabs nas su/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wa re bh+yaḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs kyi lan lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ= oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ gnyis pa 'dod pa'i don gsol btab pa ni/ rnam par rgyal ma 'khor bcas kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// bar brjod/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun 'phags ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyis bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ nad gdon bar chad rmi ltas mtshan ngan nyer 'tshe mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dpal bsod nams ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas shing blo dam pa'i chos dang mthun par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad mthar thug rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i thugs rje byams pa'i 'od dkar gyis khyab par mdzad du gsol/

khyad par yid la 'dod pa'i don// de nyid 'bad med yid bzhin du// 'grub par gsol ba drag tu gdab// gsum pa gtang rag mchod pa 'bul ba ni// mchod sprin gzungs sngags lan gsum brjod byin brlab// dwangs bsil yan lag brgyad ldan gtsang zhing bzang*// rdo rje'i mchod yon zhing khams rgya mtshor spel// 'chi med bcom ldan rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor la// mchod 'bul thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes byin rlobs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rnam dag dri med yid 'ong tshangs ral klung*// rdo rje'i zhabs bsil zhing khams rgya mtshor spel// 'chi med bcom ldan rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor la// mchod 'bul thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes byin rlobs// pā d+yaṃ/ chu dang thang skyes dga' tshal sna tshogs pa// rdo rje'i me tog zhing khams rgya mtshor spel// 'chi med bcom ldan rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor la// mchod 'bul thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes byin rlobs// puṣ+pe/ ha ri tsan+dan ma la ya rlung bskul// rdo rje'i bdug spos zhing khams rgya tshor spel// 'chi med bcom ldan rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor la// mchod 'bul thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes byin rlobs// dhū pe/ nyi zla nor bu'i 'od zer stong gsum 'bar// rdo rje'i snang gsal zhing khams rgya mtshor spel// 'chi med bcom ldan rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor la// mchod 'bul thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes byin rlobs// ā lo ke/ bsung zhim ji snyed byugs pa'i bye brag rnams// rdo rje'i dri chab zhing khams rgya mtshor spel// 'chi med bcom ldan rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor la// mchod 'bul thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes byin rlobs// gan+dhe/ lha yi bshos gtsang yid 'ong ro brgya ldan// rdo rje'i zhal zas zhing khams rgya mtshor spel// 'chi med bcom ldan rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor la// mchod 'bul thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes byin rlobs// nai wid+ya/

sgra snyan dbyangs kyi rgyud mangs srid gsum khyab// rdo rje'i rol mo zhing khams rgya mtsho spel// 'chi med bcom ldan rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor la// mchod 'bul thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes byin rlobs// shab+da āḥhūm̐/ gi bar gyis mchod/ in+d+ra snyil mtshungs ral gri pags mnyan 'jam// mtsho gling skyed tshal dbang gzhu ltar bkra'i gos// baiḍūr mchil lham bkod legs khang bzang mdzes// yid 'phrog lha rdzas bde ldan gzims cha sogs// nye ba'i rin chen dad pas 'bul lags na// 'phags nor bdun gyi dbang 'byor mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra u pa rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bzhi pa phyag 'tshal bstod pa 'bul ba ni/ tshe mtha' yas pa'i rang gzugs mchog /dus gsum rgyal kun bskyed pa'i gzhi// dpal ldan rje btsun rnam rgyal mar// phyag 'tshal yon tan brjod cing bstod// rab dkar ston zla'i kha dog can// thugs rje'i 'od snang bye ba yis// yid can ku muta gnyen gyur cing*// phyag 'tshal dad gsum bskyed cing bstod// phan bde zhi bsil bdud rtsi yis// nyon mongs ngan song tsha gdung bcom// rnam grol bde bar 'dren pa'i yum// phyag 'tshal sgo gsum 'dud bcas bstod// 'gro ba sgrol la brtse ba can// tshad med snying rje'i stobs 'chang ba// 'jig rten dbang dang gsang sngags bdag /rdo rje 'dzin par phyag 'tshal bstod// chos dbyings zhi las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyi khro chen gtum po'i sku// bzhengs nas log 'dren mthar byed pa// mi g.yo mgon dang 'dod pa'i rgyal// dbyug sngon can dang stobs po che// rdzu 'phrul dbang bsgyur phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan dgyes byed khrus chab rgyun// bsil byed rin chen bum pa bzang*// 'dzin bzhin rim gro'i mchod par brtson// lha yi khye'u chung gnyis kyang bstod// de ltar 'phags ma lha dgu dang*// dkon mchog rgya mtsho rab 'byams kyi// zhing bdag rgyal ba ma lus par// gus pa'i yid kyis lus rdul snyed// sprul nas phyag 'tshal gus pas bstod// tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med par// yang dag ye shes mchog brnyes nas// lha gcig khyod dang dbyer med shog

/ lnga pa 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bzod gsol ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ bdag ni byis blo rmongs pa yi// dbang gyur nyon mongs sgrib pas byings// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya sogs// 'gal 'khrul lhag chad ci mchis dang*// mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang zhing*// nongs par gyur pa'i las gang dag /mgon po thugs rje ldan rnams kyi// drung du bzod gsol 'phral yun gyi// sgrib par mi 'gyur dbugs dbyung nas// grub gnyis dam pa'i mchog stsol mdzod// de nas dbyangs gsal yi ge brgya pa dang*// rten 'brel snying po la sogs lan gsum brjod// drug pa bsdu rim brtan bzhugs rgyas gdab ni// oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs pa'am/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod rang gi dpral thim bsgom/ rten yod na/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes pas brtan bzhugs rab gnas mchog tu 'gyur// bdun pa bsngo ba smon lam mtshams sbyor ni// dus gsum 'jig rten sgron ma mchog rnams kyis// bsngo bar rab bsngags ji ltar bdag gis kyang*// legs byas 'dis mtshon dge tshogs klung rgyun rnams// 'gro kun byang chub rgya mtshor 'jug phyir bsngo// rgyal sras thu po rnams kyis yang dag pa// bla med thugs bskyed zab mo'i dgongs pa'i don// ji bzhin yongs bsngo zag bcas zag med kyi// ji snyed dge gang mchis pa de snyed kyang*// sems can thams cad sku lnga yongs rdzogs nas// mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo// dge ba 'dis mtshon bdag gzhan 'gro rgyud la// chags med zhen bral sbyin dang bag yod kyi// sdom la rab gnas tshul khrims yid 'byung ba'i// zug rngus gtser med bzod thob chos kun la// 'jug pa'i le lo bral ba'i brtson 'grus ldan// ting 'dzin phrag brgya g.yo med bsam gtan dang*// rnam thar sgo gsum chags thogs mi mnga' ba'i// shes rab la sogs pha rol phyin drug gi

/yon tan yongs rdzogs smon lam bzang po'i mthu// deng 'dir gegs med myur du 'grub gyur cig / brgyad pa shis brjod me tog 'thor nas su// oṃ/ 'grub par gyur cig sku yi bkra shis skye 'gag gnas med chos kyi dbyings// gsung gi bkra shis tshangs dbyangs 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs// thugs kyi bkra shis don dam 'khrul med sprul pa'i sku// rdo rje gsum ldan sku gsum bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog /rgyal yum bkra shis 'chi med mchog stsol tshe dpag med// rnam rgyal bkra shis chu shel 'od dkar cha shas gang*// gang 'dir bkra shis 'gro la nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i// bden pa dam pa'i snang bas bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog /byang sems bkra shis dam bcas 'gro la brtse ldan zhing*// 'gro 'dul bkra shis thugs rje'i spyan ras dus drug gzigs// srid zhir bkra shis thabs mkhas ngan song sdug bsngal sgrol// byams chen phrin las rmad byung bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog /gsang bdag bkra shis rgyal kun bka' yi bsdu ba po// rdor 'dzin bkra shis log smra mu stegs pham mdzad pa'i// bstan la bkra shis mi nub rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs// khor yug kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog /gtum chen bkra shis chos nyid dbyings las gar dgu'i sku// khro rgyal bkra shis mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug stobs chen// dpa' bo'i bkra shis khrag 'thung rngams brjid rol pa yis// nyon mongs bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog /gtsang gnas bkra shis dga' bde'i longs spyod dpag yas can// lha bu'i bkra shis tshangs ral bum pa bzang gtams nas// rgyal la bkra shis khrus gsol sim byed mchod 'bul mthus// srid 'gror zhi bsil rgyun gyi bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog /mchog gsum bkra shis mkha' khyab mtha' dang bral ba'i dbyings// rtsa gsum bkra shis rnam 'phrul nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gsal// phyogs bcu'i bkra shis zhing khams rgya mtsho'i dpal yon las// don gnyis nor bu mchog thob bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog

/tshangs dbang bkra shis yongs 'du sa brtol rtsa brtan cing*// rgyal chen bkra shis lo 'dab 'bras bu rtag par rgyas// dkar phyogs bkra shis rgyal bstan bla na 'degs bzhin du// skye dgu ngal 'tsho'i gzhir 'gyur bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog /bdag gzhan bkra shis rim gnyis lam bslab grur 'jug cing*// gnas skabs bkra shis bsam 'grub nyer brtson skya bas bskul// rtag tu bkra shis 'khor mtsho chu bzhi las brgal nas// thar chen zhing bgrod mthar thug bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog /phyi snod bkra shis 'byung lnga'i stobs 'phel grogs 'gyur nas// nang bcud bkra shis sems can bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// rnam kun bkra shis dam pa chos kyi skal ldan cing*// mngon mtho nges legs mchog thob bkra shis deng 'dir bde legs shog / de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing mchod pa rnams// gtsang sar gshegs sam sngags kyis byin brlab nas// dngos grub spyod sogs gang bder las kyi rjes// mi mngon par bya bsod nams tshogs chen 'thob// de ltar bcom ldan gtsug tor lha dgu yi// mchod cing bstod sgrub rim pa ngo mtshar phul// dpag bsam rkang 'thung 'dod dgu'i lo 'dab g.yo// dngos grub 'bras bu g.yur du za bzhin par// 'bad med re skong yongs kyi spyi nor skal// spel ba'i legs byas dge gang mchis so cog /dpal ldan rdo rje can zhabs yun du gnas// bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur khyab// bdag sogs bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// ltos bcas 'brel dang thogs med ma gyur rnams// nyon shes sgrib tshogs bag chags drungs phyung nas// myang 'das mngon par 'tshang rgya nyid gyur cig /tshul bzhin 'gal 'khrul nongs gyur tshe rabs kyi// sdig dang lhan cig bzod bzhes dag tshangs stsol// ces pa'ang bkra shis zur mang lhun grub gling gi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gar dbang chos skyong 'gyur med kyis bka' gnang ltar/
si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos sa zla'i yar tshes bzang por bkod pa dge bar gyur cig /shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/// /
